name: The Missing Courier
summary: Ginro Hearthkindle searches Feralas's coast for Raschal, missing for about a week. Raschal set out for Thalanaar, planning to row down the coast. Ginro could not find the boat and asks you to search the shore for a clue.

sections.title: A Route Down the Coast
sections.body:
Ginro Hearthkindle believes Raschal planned to row down the coast toward Thalanaar. Raschal set out about a week ago and knows Feralas well. Raschal has served with the expeditionary forces since General Feathermoon led them here.

The route crosses southern Feralas, away from the Horde camp. Ginro could not find the boat, so it may be hidden or sunk. It could hold a clue to Raschal's whereabouts. On the mainland, the Forgotten Coast runs south from the jetty.

sections.title: At the Shore
sections.body:
Through muddy water, a wrecked row boat lies riddled with gaping holes along one side. It is shredded nearly to its wooden frame. Whatever struck the boat seems to have tried to split it in half.

A small crest of Feathermoon Stronghold is painted on the other side. In the mud at the boat's base, something metallic glints.

faq.answer: Raschal is the missing courier. Raschal knows Feralas well and has served with the expeditionary forces since General Feathermoon led them here.
Raschal was heading to Thalanaar. The plan was to row down the coast, then cross southern Feralas to avoid the Horde camp.

faq.q: How long has Raschal been missing?
faq.answer: Raschal has been missing about a week, since setting out for Thalanaar.
You began the search after speaking with Ginro Hearthkindle about the missing courier.
